Grounding recovers ~30% of the regression but does not close it -- still net negative at tol0. 101/181 (56%) of ungrounded Group-B's flagged paragraphs survive day-level grounding, far above the 1.6% grounded share found in the corpus-wide 40-day two-sided sample, because day-level grounding only checks whether SOME enriched resolution that date claims the name, not the specific paragraph's true owner resolution -- a coarser, more permissive check.
